note: External services DNA OS talks to. For each: does the provider force a fixed endpoint, does it vary by region/environment, is there an official SDK/discovery endpoint, is the API versioned. Values that vary per environment must be MOVE_TO_CONFIG/MOVE_TO_ENV even though the provider's PATH shape may be a PROTOCOL_CONSTANT.

endpoint_varies_by: project (per DNA OS Supabase project id)
entries.protocol_constant_part: PostgREST path conventions (/rest/v1/...) may live in a service adapter module
forbidden_locations: any literal project URL or key in application code
entries.rationale: Project URL and keys differ per environment and are partially secret.
entries.validation_rule: no literal Supabase project hostname (the *.supabase[.]co pattern) outside env-var read — worded with a bracket here so this rule description doesn't itself trip scripts/pre-commit-check.sh's own literal-substring check (owner, 2026-08-05)

entries.must_come_from: api.line.me is a fixed, provider-mandated host (LINE does not offer per-region endpoints) — safe as PROTOCOL_CONSTANT in the LINE service adapter
forbidden_locations: duplicated literal host string in multiple files
entries.rationale: Provider documents this as a fixed endpoint; the channel access TOKEN (secret) is the part that must come from env, not the host.
entries.validation_rule: host constant appears exactly once, in the adapter module; token read from env

entries.rationale: Already the subject of a real fix during the DOMAIN program (2026-07-13/14) — production URL must never be hardcoded since it changes across environments.
entries.validation_rule: no literal dnaos.dev outside config/system-links.ts default fallback (if any) and env docs
